deploy-bot: :rocket: Started canary rollout: release v1.27.3 -> prod (canary: 10%). Change window: 2025-05-14 22:00-23:00 UTC. Release notes mention secret rotation + feature flag toggle. CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345
Mia: seeing 504s from canary pods for /api/generate, approx 22:02 UTC. Latency spike in metrics.
Kevin: can you paste the pod logs? my hunch: secret rotation didn't hit prod — staging has the new key, prod still on old.
Sam: quick diff I ran:
```
# staging
kubectl -n inference get secret model-creds -o jsonpath='{.data.MODEL_KEY}' | base64 --decode
=> model_key_v3
# prod
kubectl -n inference get secret model-creds -o jsonpath='{.data.MODEL_KEY}' | base64 --decode
=> model_key_v2
```
Sam: staging has v3, prod v2. seems rotation step skipped for prod.
Liz: looking at release job logs — rotation step ran behind a conditional: `if [ \"$ENV\" = \"staging\" ]` which explains it. Pushing fix now.
Mia: can we pause the canary and avoid sending more traffic?
deploy-bot: Canary paused by Mia at 2025-05-14T22:04:12Z :pause_button:
Kevin: recommendation: pin prod to previous image (v1.27.2) while pipeline fix lands, to avoid further regressions. Patch image and scale canary to 0.
Sam: applying hotfix now: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=registry.redwood/inference:1.27.2 && kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference` (started at 22:07).
deploy-bot: Hotfix applied by Sam — prod image pinned to 1.27.2. Canary scaled to 0. No new canary traffic.
Oncall Bot: Observability: error rate back to baseline within 3m of patch, 22:10 UTC. Closing alert.
Liz: I'll open a postmortem and add a pipeline test that runs secret rotation for prod path + ensure conditional removed. Also schedule a re-run of rotation during a change window tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Mia: thanks — also please add a release note update and chart the impact in the postmortem.
Liz: will do. action items: (1) patch pipeline (PR #678), (2) add e2e check for rotation, (3) run rotation in change window, (4) add a canary monitor for secret mismatch.
Mia: closing thread when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
